patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Bombora and Snov.io share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Bombora only if your buying job matches “Intent-data specialist (Company Surge®) for B2B account prioritization — not a contact dat” rather than Snov.io's shape. Choose Snov.io only if your buying job matches “Budget SMB email finder, verifier, and cold email sequencer — Free/trial entry; Starter fr” rather than Bombora's shape. Workflow advantage: Bombora leans lead-management; Snov.io leans email-outreach. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Bombora and Snov.io share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Bombora is Intent-data specialist (Company Surge®) for B2B account prioritization — not a contact database; custom-quote packaging.; Snov.io is Budget SMB email finder, verifier, and cold email sequencer — Free/trial entry; Starter from $39/mo..
- Company-size focus: Bombora (mid-market, enterprise) vs Snov.io (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Bombora-leaning lead-management vs Snov.io-leaning email-outreach.
- Researched limits: Bombora — Intent-data specialist — not a B2B email/phone contact database; Snov.io — No forever-free plan documented as primary entry — evaluation is trial-led.

Limitations — Bombora: Intent-data specialist — not a B2B email/phone contact database; Custom-quote only via speak-to-an-expert path; Snov.io: No forever-free plan documented as primary entry — evaluation is trial-led; Contact database depth is lighter than ZoomInfo/Apollo-class breadth claims.

Poor-fit cases: Bombora is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Intent-data specialist — not a B2B email/phone contact database · Snov.io is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No forever-free plan documented as primary entry — evaluation is trial-led · Avoid Bombora if you actually need Snov.io's motion (Budget SMB email finder, verifier, and cold email sequencer — Free/trial entry; )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
